491 newly permitted drill pads. A 30,000-metre program. A fourth rig arriving by month-end—and drilling fully funded through 2026.

candidates.author: Peter Krauth
candidates.text:
Kingsmen 
@Kingsmen_Res
 just delivered 1.40m of 433 g/t AgEq at Las Coloradas, including 0.75m of 787 g/t AgEq.

Strong grades—but the real opportunity may be the untested ground between Kingsmen’s best hits. The zone remains open at depth and along strike, with more assays coming

candidates.author: Lobo Tiggre
candidates.text:
Not exactly.

I'm not buying gold and silver stocks without much lower entry points.

If that means they take off without me, so be it.

I'll make money buying whatever does go on sale next—don't care which commodity it is.

candidates.author: Lobo Tiggre
candidates.text:
Nonsense.

I haven't sold an ounce of gold or silver, nor have I told anyone to do so.

I did sell my stocks—at levels higher than today's.

(And I remain just as vocal.)

If you're going to diss me, at least do it for what I actually say and do.
